8172.title: Unbounded event batches lose queued data during retry
8172.rootCauseOneLine: An unbounded failed upload is spread into queue.unshift after in-flight accounting is cleared; argument overflow prevents restoration and loses the backlog.

prReviews.topFinding: A 500-event cap and in-place compaction address the verified mechanism; linked PR code was not executed.

8172.proposedFix: Bound daemon uploads and avoid unbounded argument spreads while preserving retries and per-thread order. Existing open PR #8173 links this issue; no duplicate fix PR created.
8172.caveats: Node 22.19.0 here, not the reporter's runtime. Timings measure the full in-process request, not just its transaction. Timer-start rejection and waiting-queue overflow were source-inspected, not separately exercised.
